name: Capri
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features a rich chocolate brown base with a slightly deeper root. Fine chestnut ribbons run through the lengths, adding subtle warmth and dimension. The brightest pieces are at the hairline, where slim toasted caramel highlights frame the face. The overall color stays a deep brunette from root to tip.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair, and touch her up after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final.
